closeout_failures.failed_witness: The combined post-push fetch and four-way-equality wrapper reached its 30-second bound after Git had already acknowledged the x2 push; its fresh-live subprocesses briefly remained and no complete equality projection was returned.
closeout_failures.recovery: Did not repeat the push, inspected and waited for the exact transient processes, then used split scalar local, upstream, tracking, divergence, clean-state, and fresh-live probes.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep a session handle for network wrappers or separate the push from fresh-live equality probes before the command begins.

closeout_failures.failed_witness: The first split equality recovery left HEAD...@{u} unquoted in PowerShell, which misprojected the upstream expression and caused only that read-only divergence probe to fail.
closeout_failures.recovery: Quoted the complete revision expression as HEAD...@{u}; the corrected probe returned zero ahead and zero behind with exact four-way equality.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Quote Git revision expressions containing PowerShell hashtable syntax characters.

closeout_failures.failed_witness: The first combined final-delta, final-owner, JSON, runner, stale-label, and baton-word precommit projection exceeded its 10-second wrapper while replaying more than one hundred index blobs and returned no attributable result.
closeout_failures.recovery: Confirmed the exact read-only processes had exited, then split final-delta and final-owner manifest replay from JSON, runner, stale-label, and word-count checks.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Run large owner-manifest replay as its own bounded probe with a longer output window rather than combining it with unrelated checks.

closeout_failures.failed_witness: The first split document-hygiene projection used a single-quoted PowerShell character class containing backtick-t, so it treated the literal letter t as whitespace and falsely flagged ordinary lines.
closeout_failures.recovery: Repeated only the document-hygiene dependency with an explicit hexadecimal tab class, consistent with the already-passing Python final test.
closeout_failures.recurrence_guard: Use [ \x09] rather than a PowerShell escape sequence inside a single-quoted regex character class.
